title: Spontaneous order needs a separately earned uniform response modulus
statement: Let e be even concave thermodynamic energy density, m(h)=-e-prime(h), m_D=-e-prime(0+), q(h)=[e(0)-e(h)]/h. With rigorous L0<=e0<=U0 and Lh<=eh<=Uh, 0<=m_D<=q(h)<=(U0-Lh)/h. If separately PROVED distributional susceptibility0<=m-prime(s)<=K for0<s<h, then m_D>=(L0-Uh)/h-Kh/2. K is a physical certificate with uniform field/volume scope, not convenient assumed constant. A finite-size unique gap Delta and Var(D_L)<=C L^2 can give -e_L-second<=2C/Delta only if these are uniform in needed field/volume/selected sector; near-degenerate symmetry sectors are consequential. Transverse paramagnet H0=(I-X)/2 has e(h)=(1-sqrt(1+4h^2))/2, at h1/4 secant sqrt5-2>0 but spontaneous m0=0; K2 paymentKh/2=1/4 kills false inference. Ordered defect control e=-|h| has K0/m1. Old energy width.114122/h.01=11.4122 exceeds density bound.75, so no old energy-only phase inference. Proposed structured-SDP lower/normalized variational upper/source sweep remains conditional until actual frustrated-model uniform dimer curvature modulus is earned. No phase certificate or global quantum-marginal reconstruction is supplied.

requires: Even periodic L square spin-1/2 J1-J2 at alpha=1/2; D_L=sum (-1)^x S_xy dot S_x+1,y; e(h)=lim lambda_min(H-hD)/L^2; m_D=-e-prime(0+). Observable norm density <=3/4. Positive m_D selects only columnar pi,0 bond order. Zero excludes only this component, not vertical/plaquette/topological/gapless alternatives.

Each positive control has its own exact sector/model assumptions; source-faithful quantum dimer basis is orthogonal and has specified positive rational edge amplitudes. Finite-field lower bound needs independently proved uniform field/volume curvature modulus.
